name: Proof Obligation Registry for MT Series
purpose: Create explicit proof obligations for MT-001, MT-002, and MT-003 from FSUB dependencies.

proof_obligations.name: Π_A restricted projection idempotence

obligations.statement: Formally define Π_A application over X_alpha x A_alpha.
Derive that Π_A(Π_A(x, A)) is equivalent to Π_A(x, A) under projection_equivalence.
Identify the set of stable neighborhood conditions required for convergence.

proof_obligations.failure_criteria: Existence of a non-idempotent stable neighborhood counterexample.

proof_obligations.name: NavT restricted transport identity

obligations.statement: Declare the formal orientation-space Ω_alpha and transport equivalence relation.
Derive the conditions under which NavT preserves relational identity across indices.
Map orientation locking failures to transport identity breakdown.

proof_obligations.failure_criteria: Relational identity collapse during bounded index-traversal.

proof_obligations.name: δ non-empty admissible image

obligations.statement: Formalize δ selection semantics (relational vs map).
Prove that the mismatch condition (E≠0) and admissibility set A_alpha imply a non-empty image Im_A.
Establish the tie-breaking policy for degenerate admissible images.

proof_obligations.failure_criteria: Reaching an actualization gap where δ is undefined despite non-null mismatch.

governance_rules.rule: Every proof obligation must remain traceable to the FSUB formal substrate.
Obligations are considered 'satisfied' only after formal review; candidate support does not constitute satisfaction.

forbidden_claims: Obligation mapping proves the theorem's validity.
